additional_leads.reason: With the optional async path enabled, the completion for captured student A puts A data in _asyncStudentData then recursively renders using the current selector value. If the selector changed to B while A was loading, B can label/action A sessions; a late rejection can also overwrite the current view. There is no selector/generation check before either write. The flag is false by default, so this lead concerns the opt-in path; source supported and not reproduced.
